column1: # Semantic-search ground truth. Format: query<TAB>relevant file(s), comma separated. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Every query is worded to avoid the distinctive words of the document it should find, so ranking it
# correctly takes meaning rather than shared vocabulary. A lexical matcher should do badly here on purpose.
how does a ship tell one coastal navigation beacon apart from another
what did the person living at a shore signal station do through the night
how do people make greens keep for months by letting microbes sour them
why does a mountainside of packed white suddenly let go and slide
why does a shadow clock disagree with a wristwatch depending on the season
how does a pulp slurry become a flat surface you can write on
how do young flocks know where to travel when nobody has shown them
why is every key on a keyboard instrument left a little off from exact ratios
why does any flat drawing of the whole globe distort something
how does a clinician judge how far under a patient is during an operation
what makes a very heavy star tear itself apart at the end of its life
where did the heavier elements in the universe come from
why must molten material on a pipe be rotated without pause while it is formed
what happens when long frozen soil begins to soften
how is distance underwater worked out from a returning sound
why does a heap of garden waste start to stink instead of breaking down cleanly
why is a volume stitched through the fold rather than simply stuck at the edge
why does the wind over a subcontinent switch direction with the seasons
why does the lump that grows inside an oyster have a rainbow sheen
how does a kitchen appliance move warmth out of its own interior
why does colour wash straight back out of fabric unless it is treated first
why must iron be struck only while it sits in a particular heat range
